# Elsevier

> Elsevier is a global leader in advanced information and decision support for science, research, and healthcare, offering AI-powered publishing, research analytics, and clinical tools.

Elsevier provides comprehensive digital solutions for academic institutions, healthcare professionals, researchers, and industry partners. The platform integrates peer-reviewed content, research analytics, clinical decision support, and AI-powered tools to advance scientific discovery and healthcare outcomes.

## Key Topics

- ScienceDirect
- Scopus
- ClinicalKey AI
- LeapSpace
- Osmosis AI
- Research publishing
- Clinical decision support
- AI-powered research tools
- Peer-reviewed journals
- Academic publishing

- Manuscript submission
- Clinical guidelines
- Scientific databases

## Core Research & Publishing Platforms

- [ScienceDirect](https://www.elsevier.com/products/sciencedirect): ScienceDirect peer-reviewed literature database with AI search capabilities.
- [Scopus](https://www.elsevier.com/products/scopus): Scopus abstract and citation database with AI-powered research discovery.
- [Elsevier Journal Catalog](https://www.elsevier.com/products/journals): Comprehensive journal catalog with search tools and manuscript submission options.
- [Products Catalog](https://www.elsevier.com/products): Product catalog with access to digital solutions and research tools.

## Clinical & Healthcare Solutions

- [ClinicalKey](https://www.elsevier.com/products/clinicalkey): ClinicalKey evidence-based clinical decision support for healthcare professionals.
- [ClinicalKey AI Updates](https://www.elsevier.com/products/clinicalkey/clinicalkey-ai/redefined): ClinicalKey AI updates, features, and transparency enhancements for clinical use.
- [Health Resources](https://www.elsevier.com/health): Healthcare resources and clinical products including ClinicalKey AI and STATdx.

## AI-Powered Learning & Research Tools

- [Osmosis AI](https://www.elsevier.com/products/osmosis/osmosis-ai): Osmosis AI conversational AI partner for medical education and learning.
- [LeapSpace](https://www.elsevier.com/products/leapspace/introducing-research-grade-ai): LeapSpace AI workspace for academic and corporate research collaboration.

## Solutions by Sector

- [Academic & Government Solutions](https://www.elsevier.com/academic-and-government): Academic and research solutions featuring ScienceDirect, Scopus, SciVal, and LeapSpace.
- [Industry R&D Solutions](https://www.elsevier.com/industry): R&D and enterprise solutions for industry innovation, data analytics, and drug discovery.

## Editorial & Peer Review Resources

- [Resources for Editors](https://www.elsevier.com/editor): Editorial tools, guidance, and resources for journal editors using Elsevier.
- [Resources for Reviewers](https://www.elsevier.com/reviewer): Peer review guidance, resources, and support for manuscript reviewers.

## Company & Support

- [About Elsevier](https://www.elsevier.com/about): Company mission, leadership, and commitment to research integrity and healthcare.
- [Support & Help](https://www.elsevier.com/support): FAQ and support contact options for Elsevier products including ClinicalKey and Evolve.
- [Elsevier Connect](https://www.elsevier.com/connect): News and features for research, health, and technology communities.

## Optional

- [Elsevier Books](https://shop.elsevier.com/books): Elsevier books catalog featuring textbooks, research publications, and eBooks.
- [Award-Winning Books](https://shop.elsevier.com/award-books): Award-winning Elsevier publications recognized for excellence and impact.
